start.topic: Perimeter of rectangles, squares and polygons
start.opening: Namaste Kabir, main Asha, aapki AI teacher hoon. Aaj perimeter padhenge. Aapko rectangles ya squares mein se kya zyada familiar hai?

turns.line: samajh nahi aaya, ek example se samjhao
turns.reply: Jaise garden ko fence karna ho: perimeter matlab boundary ki total lambai. 6 m aur 4 m sides mein aap kaunsi lengths jodenge?
Rectangle ki chaar sides hoti hain: 6 m, 4 m, 6 m, 4 m. Perimeter ke liye sab jodiye: 6 plus 4 plus 6 plus 4 kitna?

turns.board: Rani runs 3 rounds of a rectangular park 50 m long and 30 m wide. How far does she run?
turns.reply: Chaliye saath ginte hain: 6 plus 4 equals 10, phir 6 plus 4 equals 10; total 20 m. Ab rectangle ki chaar sides boliye.
